description: National Walking and Cycling Participation Survey - CWANZ is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Cycling and Walking Australia and New Zealand (CWANZ). The National Walking and Cycling Participation Survey provides insight into walking and cycling activity across Australia and is a successor to the National Cycling Participation Survey which was conducted biennially from 2011 to 2019. Coverage is Australia, 2021 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as less than annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-02-24. Files and pages listed: HTML (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
